_rationale: RMD at 74 = 4,590,000 / 25.5 = $180,000 exactly. Spending $108k. As ordinary income, federal tax on $180k (single, 2026 std deduction) is roughly $30-36k; FL has no state tax; no LTCG since fromBrokerage = 0; NIIT = 0 since MAGI $180k < $200k single threshold. Net of tax, the RMD provides ~$145-150k cash — comfortably more than the $108k spending need. The RMD-first waterfall absorbs the entire spending need into the RMD's spending pull, so withdrawalFromBrokerage stays at exactly 0. Excess RMD (rmdRequired minus spending pull = $180k - ($108k + tax)) reinvests into the existing Taxable account, so Taxable grows year-over-year and Traditional shrinks by the full RMD each year.
